guarantees.claim: err_processed is the bitwise AND of reg2hw.cmd.err_processed.q and reg2hw.cmd.err_processed.qe.
reg_kmac_en is directly assigned from reg2hw.cfg_shadowed.kmac_en.q.
reg_sha3_mode is the type-cast of reg2hw.cfg_shadowed.mode.q to sha3_mode_e.
reg_keccak_strength is the type-cast of reg2hw.cfg_shadowed.kstrength.q to keccak_strength_e.
event_absorbed is the result of prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_test_true_strict(app_absorbed), which returns 1 for strict true encoding.

assumptions.claim: The register field `cmd.err_processed` in reg_top is latched (write-clear) such that `q` and `qe` are cleared after `err_processed` rises, ensuring a pulse.
assumptions.risk: If not latched, err_processed may stay high causing repeated error processing.

assumptions.claim: app_absorbed is a valid mubi4_t multi-bit signal (proper encoding) so that mubi4_test_true_strict correctly interprets true/false.
assumptions.risk: Invalid encoding may cause event_absorbed to be incorrectly asserted or missed, leading to spurious/lost interrupts.

assumptions.claim: The shadow register values `mode.q` and `kstrength.q` are always legal members of the enums `sha3_mode_e` and `keccak_strength_e` respectively.
assumptions.risk: Illegal enum values propagate to `reg_sha3_mode` and `reg_keccak_strength`, possibly causing undefined behavior in the SHA-3/KECCAK core.
